title: Grateful Dead Live at Community War Memorial Auditorium on 1982-04-09
lineage: Analog Sound Preservation: MAC >> Nakamichi DRAGON => Korg MR-1000 >> DSF [1-bit / 5.8 MHz Stereo] >>  Korg AudioGate >> WAV [24/96]
source: FOB Sennheiser 421 > Sony TC-D5M > MAC; Master Cassettes (MAC) Medium Stock Brands: MAC = Maxell UDXLII-S Analog

ai_review.summary: Excellent clean audience tape of a smoking Rochester 4/9/82 show, highlighted by a blazing first set and standout Birdsong, To Lay Me Down, The Other One and Stella Blue.
ai_review.review: The performance is described as "smokin'" from the opening Bama>Greatest Story to a fire‑filled first set that rolls into a superb second set featuring emotional ballads and soaring jams. Reviewers rave about Birdsong, To Lay Me Down, The Other One, Stella Blue and other classics, while noting the recording is a very clean audience capture mastered well by Jim Vita.

ai_rating.rationale: All three detailed reviews are highly positive (5, 5, 4 stars), praising both the musical performance and the tape quality; no criticisms were noted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very clean audience recording; praised as an excellent tape with good mastering by Jim Vita, no reported dropouts or muffiness.

standout_songs: Going Down the Road Feeling Bad
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds a blaze of fire from the opener through China Cat Sunflower; second set balances tender ballads with high‑energy jams, ending on a smiling note.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals (and implied guitar work) highlighted as strong, especially during Birdsong and The Other One.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals praised; reviewers noted the JG/BW voices were excellent in this era.
